answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor every identity to one verifiable work thread: before an agent may trade, it stakes a small refundable bond on a single thread of completed, peer-checked tasks, and the bond is slashed if the thread forks into duplicates. Reputation then accrues like a nebula condensing around real work rather than spreading thin across sockpuppets, while an umber audit trail marks each bond so clones cannot hide behind fresh names. One body, one thread, one stake: a hundred fake agents costs a hundred real bonds.
